voice_description: A young woman's voice in her twenties, American English. Bright, friendly and a little girly, yet composed and polished: the warm, clear, evenly paced delivery of a smartphone voice assistant. Crisp consonants, smooth intonation, light smile in the tone, medium-high pitch, no vocal fry, no breathiness, no exaggerated acting.
text: In many Filipino classrooms, the internet is the first thing to fail. So we built a math tutor that does not need it. SIBOL. An offline-first math companion for Grades 4 to 6, in English, Tagalog, and Taglish.
